name: Netease Music CLI
headline: netease-music-cli: Terminal Music Control
short_description: `ncm-cli` is a command line tool that allows users to manage Netease Cloud Music with capabilities like playback, search, and queue management. This skill is designed for users who want to control their music experience via the command line.
author: netease

sections.overview:
netease-music-cli (ncm-cli) is a command-line interface for managing Netease Cloud Music directly from your terminal. It enables song playback, search, queue management, playlist creation, and playback controls like pause, skip, and volume adjustment. The tool requires installation and user authentication via API keys, with support for both built-in (mpv) and external players. Users can search for songs, create playlists, manage playback state, and control music without switching applications.
Play music from Netease Cloud
Search for songs and albums
Manage music queue
Login check for user access
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/netease/skills --skill netease-music-cli`
